method.cpu: Cloudflare live-tail per-invocation cpuTime; HTTP caller and PasswordCrypto Durable Object roots measured independently
method.wall: Cloudflare wallTime; client monotonic fetch-to-response-headers duration, excluding JSON decoding/sign-out/MFA completion; application performance.now timers remain wall measurements and were frozen at zero in the CPU-only DO operation
method.quantiles: Median averages the two central observations for even sample counts; P95 uses nearest rank
method.baselineTraceIds: Unavailable: CLI cannot query persisted telemetry (403); request UUID and Cloudflare Ray IDs identify each baseline invocation
method.featureTraceIds: Native spanContext trace ID and span ID recorded in safe metadata; every caller matched to exactly one PasswordCrypto invocation
method.signIn: Password acceptance yielding the normal TOTP challenge; second-factor enrollment used the normal setup/confirmation/recovery-code acknowledgment routes
method.warmup: Three per successful and missing-account group; random sharding means this does not warm every object
method.scope: No production deploy, subscription changes, CPU-limit override, public benchmark route, or Free enforcement test

localBenchmark.cpuScope: entire local workerd process; upper bound only
